_comment: Copy to worker-models.json (git-ignored) and point WORKER_MODELS_FILE at it.
Each entry is registered with the app's model registry at worker start; the app assigns the modelId
that agent.run payloads carry, and the worker maps it back to this entry.
stage: base | sft | grpo | test. 'base' is stored as the app's 'zero_shot'.
Only add an sft/grpo entry once the adapter directory (adapter_config.json + adapter_model.safetensors)
or the merged checkpoint directory actually exists. SFT and GRPO have not been run yet.
A 'test' entry is the LM Studio / OpenAI-compatible backend: it is labelled 'Test backend (not the
research model)' in the app and its rows are excluded from cohort statistics by default (ADR-0025).
adapterPath (LoRA) and checkpointDir+checkpointTag (merged) are alternatives and torch_hf only.

models.label: Qwen3.5-9B base (research path, no adapter)
models.notes: Loaded through VLM-DENTAL's load_model; 4-bit NF4 when CUDA is present.

models.label: Qwen3.5-4B via LM Studio (test backend)
models.notes: Test backend, not the research model. WORKER_OPENAI_BASE_URL defaults to http://localhost:1234/v1.
